source: REAL ERA5 (ARCO GCP public raw NetCDF) for 2025-09-30 00 UTC, coarsened to ~1°. Lightning from Blitzortung historical map (limaps.org) for the same time — digitized strike pixels for overlays; step 1 shows the Blitzortung image/embed, not a synthetic grid.

blitzortung.note: Open historical maps, set Date=30 Sep 2025 and Time=00:00 UTC (world/earth map).

lightning.name: Lightning (Blitzortung)
lightning.provenance: Digitized from Blitzortung/limaps historical earth overlay 2025-09-30 00:00 UTC — not synthetic.

precip.name: Total precipitation
precip.note: ERA5 tp at 00 UTC converted m→mm (hourly accumulation field).

rh700.name: Mid-level RH (~700 hPa)
rh700.era5: computed from temperature + specific_humidity at 700 hPa
rh700.note: RH from Tetens es(T) and e(q,p=700hPa). Not archived RH.
